youtube.title: Naak band karke hum kyun nahi kar sakte? 🤐 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Kabhi naak pinch karke aur muh band karke hum karne ki koshish ki hai? Awaaz ruk jaati hai. Kyunki hum karne ke liye aapki awaaz ko bahar behti hawa chahiye.

Muh band ho toh hawa ke paas sirf ek raasta bachta hai, naak. Use bhi band kar do, toh hawa ke paas jaane ki jagah nahi. Muh aur gale mein pressure banta hai, vocal cords vibrate nahi kar paate, aur hum ruk jaata hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
